messages:
sasha: FYI were rolling out a new prepaid credit pool feature + 7-day overage-smoothing next week. short note + links below.

sasha: Goal: give customers a low-friction way to pre-fund usage for variable workloads and avoid single-day overage spikes on invoices.

mike: Quick mechanics: create a USD pool; charges draw from pool first. If empty, fall back to normal metered billing or a configured fallback. Prepay is charged at creation.

billing-bot: Refunds: customers can request unused-balance refunds within 30 days. small processing fee: 2% under $100, waived if >$100.

tara: CLI example: 
```
redwood billing pools create --name "edge-prepay" --amount 2500 --region us-east-1
```

ops-bot: Rollout: billing-service v3.10.0, canary Friday 03:00 UTC then global. Feature flag: billing.prepay_pools.v1. Expect console UI toggle.

kevin: Note: free-trial credits remain separate and will not be consumed by a prepaid pool. pools do not change rate limits or quota enforcement.

sasha: Docs + CS one-pager will go live with the Console banner on Tuesday 16:00 PT. Please review the internal doc and add any legal/accounting asks.
